# Roadrunner Media

> Premium real estate photography and videography serving Phoenix, AZ and the greater Valley. FAA-licensed drone. 24-hour delivery. 500+ properties photographed. Packages from $250.

## About

Roadrunner Media is a Phoenix-based real estate media company founded by Colin, a professional photographer and FAA-licensed drone pilot. The business serves real estate agents, brokers, and investors across the Phoenix metro area (Maricopa County). Core differentiators: guaranteed 24-hour photo delivery, FAA-licensed aerial drone on every aerial shoot, and transparent flat-rate pricing with no hidden fees.

## Services

- Real Estate Photography: HDR interior and exterior photos, drone/neighborhood aerials, virtual staging, 2D floor plans, marketing materials, twilight sessions, and social media edits.
- Video Tours: Cinematic 4K walk-through videos with aerial drone footage, licensed music, branded intro/outro, color grading, and MLS + social versions.
- Agent Headshots: Solo and brand sessions with 10–25 edited photos, outfit changes, multiple locations, LinkedIn/social crops.
- Logo & Brand Design: Custom logo concepts, full brand guides, business card design, email signature kits, and complete brand strategy.

## Pricing

- Photos: Essential $250 | Standard $350 | Premium $550
- Video: Essential $299 | Standard $499 | Premium $799
- Headshots: Solo Session $199 | Brand Session $349 | Team Package $199/person
- Logos: Starter $299 | Brand Kit $549 | Full Identity $999

All packages include no upfront payment required to schedule. Custom quotes available via email.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does real estate photography cost in Phoenix?**
Roadrunner Media offers real estate photography packages starting at $250 for the Essential package (25–35 HDR photos, drone aerials, virtual staging, 2D floor plan, and marketing materials). The Standard package is $350 and the Premium package is $549. All packages include no upfront payment to schedule, 24-hour photo delivery, and a complimentary property website. Custom quotes are available for large properties or unique requirements via email at colin@roadrunner.media.

**What is included in a real estate photography package?**
Every Roadrunner Media photography package includes HDR interior and exterior photos, drone aerial photography (FAA-licensed), virtual staging options, a 2D floor plan, and a complimentary property website. Higher-tier packages add twilight sessions, social media edits, and additional edited photos. There are no hidden add-on fees — drone coverage is included in every package, not charged separately.

**How quickly will I receive my listing photos after the shoot?**
All photo packages include guaranteed 24-hour delivery. Photos are delivered via the Aryeo platform, which provides a shareable online gallery, direct MLS-ready downloads, and social media crops. Most deliveries arrive within 12–18 hours of the shoot. Twilight and luxury packages are delivered within 24–72 hours due to additional editing time.

**What cities and areas do you serve in the Phoenix metro?**
Roadrunner Media serves the entire Phoenix metro area including Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Glendale, Peoria, and the greater Maricopa County Valley. There is no travel fee within the Phoenix metro. Custom quotes are available for properties outside the Valley.

**Is a drone pilot license required for real estate aerial photography in Arizona?**
Yes. Commercial drone photography in Arizona requires an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate. Roadrunner Media's founder Colin holds an active FAA Part 107 certification, which is required by law for any commercial aerial photography or videography. Hiring an unlicensed drone operator exposes the property owner and agent to FAA fines. All Roadrunner Media aerial shoots are fully compliant and insured.

**What is the difference between the Essential, Standard, and Premium photography packages?**
The Essential package ($250) covers standard residential properties up to approximately 2,500 sq ft and includes 25–35 HDR photos, drone aerials, virtual staging, a 2D floor plan, and a property website. The Standard package ($350) adds more edited photos (35–50), a social media reel, and twilight coverage for properties up to 4,000 sq ft. The Premium package ($549) is designed for luxury and large properties with 50+ edited photos, a full twilight session, aerial video, and priority scheduling. All three include the same 24-hour delivery guarantee.
